archive_authority_and_scope: The helper pins one exact index path and SHA, one exact retained request05 path and SHA, one exact helper path, and fixed archive path, compressed SHA/length, tar length, historical source label, 96-member count, and payload total.

Strict JSON parsing rejects duplicate object keys. Index records require exact fields, canonical sorted unique member paths under the fixed raw-capture prefix, lowercase SHA-256 values, exact integer sizes, and the fixed aggregate payload size.

The retained request05 bytes are checked against their fixed SHA before parsing; its historical expected_head is kept separate from current HEAD. Its exact 96 raw.json paths and digests must equal the index member set. The request05's unrelated stale ordinary ref is not added to the current source closure; the focused regression fixture asserts current ordinary bytes SHA 41f0f5c6a57557aa11d43e93e6049ba808282527053969ac86f47e7753055335 while request05 carries obsolete SHA 9500ad6c863ae06fb354eaa3fa51429ee4bd742a7fefbc5cc3de63898ad02009, and confirms omission of that obsolete extra does not hide any indexed member.

Only the exact 96 indexed raw paths receive the archive fallback. Additional missing refs, including a raw path outside the index and a non-raw path inside the prefix, fail. All remaining request source refs must match direct current-HEAD Git blobs.
archive_parser_and_live_binding: The helper hashes bounded compressed bytes, accepts exactly one complete gzip stream with no trailing bytes, caps decompressed output, and requires the exact indexed tar byte length.

USTAR parsing is in memory and does not extract. It checks block alignment, header checksum, USTAR magic/version, regular-file type, zero link target, canonical non-traversing names, exact indexed membership, no duplicates or extras, exact member lengths and SHA-256 values, zero padding, exact member set and payload total, and an all-zero end marker. PAX/GNU extension, symlink, hardlink, directory, and traversal forms are rejected by header/type/path rules.

Index, request05, helper, LFS part, and each live raw input are read as bounded regular files with symlink-ancestor checks and before/after identity/size/time checks. Each live raw input must equal both the parsed archive bytes and the indexed/request05 digest and length.

The verifier checks the current-HEAD LFS pointer as a Git blob with the exact three-line pointer bytes and checks its tree entry is a regular 100644 blob at the pinned path. Ordinary refs are read from Git blobs and independently checked against their declared SHA and Git object identity. Only an exact Git `path missing` response for an indexed member can reach the archive branch; operational errors, malformed/truncated/trailing replies, non-blob records, missing pointer, pointer mismatch, and ordinary missing/mismatch fail closed.
